beats.note: No runtime log exists for this pipeline (it is the pipeline that makes the clips, not a service with its own log), so this beat is evidence-by-log, not a catalog effect: a LogWindow built from the real steps of tonight's own factory run (archetype draw, beat measurement, shots.json, typecheck, GitHub render, publish) substitutes for a recording, drawn over the divider wash as it slides toward order. This also carries the clip's one tech caption ('Remotion').
